name: A Visitor to Dun Morogh
summary: Beldin Steelgrill asks you to investigate a fire on the heights above Gol'Bolar Quarry. Mountaineers have spotted a stranger's camp, and the dwarves want to know whether the visitor threatens them.

sections.title: A Smoke Plume on the Heights
sections.body: A strange fire has appeared above Gol'Bolar Quarry, drawing concern in Kharanos. Dun Morogh's mountaineers watch the crags and snowy valleys around Ironforge, and an unfamiliar camp on the heights is hard to ignore. Beldin Steelgrill asks you to climb the ridge and learn whether the stranger above the dwarven excavation means harm.

sections.title: Meeting the Earthseer
sections.body: Earthseer Farsen has made camp on the heights above Gol'Bolar Quarry. He is a mystic with deep ties to the earth, not a marauding trogg or hostile spy. His presence overlooks the quarry, and his watch leads into disturbances beneath Khaz Modan and the mystery of the Hall of Thanes.

faq.q: Who sends you to investigate the visitor?
faq.answer: Beldin Steelgrill, outside Kharanos, asks you to investigate after mountaineers report an unfamiliar fire in the hills.

faq.q: Where is the mysterious campsite located?
faq.answer: The campfire burns high on the snowy ridges east of Kharanos, above Gol'Bolar Quarry.

faq.q: Who is the visitor overlooking the quarry?
faq.answer: The visitor is Earthseer Farsen, a spiritual observer camped on the heights above the quarry.

faq.q: Why were the dwarves suspicious of the campfire?
faq.answer: The dwarves are wary because the unknown camp overlooks Gol'Bolar Quarry, a critical operation already under pressure from local troggs. They fear it may belong to scouts or hostile forces watching their movements.

faq.q: What does this quest lead into?
faq.answer: Speaking with Earthseer Farsen leads to Farsen's Watch and begins the Hall of Thanes attunement chain.

faq.q: Do you need to fight the stranger at the camp?
faq.answer: No. Beldin Steelgrill warns you to be ready for violence, but Earthseer Farsen is a peaceful observer willing to speak with you.

angles.text: As a Bronzebeard dwarf, you know why the mountaineers watch strangers above major mining sites like Gol'Bolar to guard Khaz Modan's borders.
As a shaman, you meet Earthseer Farsen, whose communion with the mountain stones is rare in Dun Morogh's snowy highlands.
As an Alliance member, you help the mountaineers outside Kharanos protect the supply lines and quarry workers from unforeseen threats.
